entities.name: ArgJ
observations: The 407-aa query matches reviewed ArgJ proteins at about 49% identity with 99–100% query coverage; enzyme assignment is supported by homology.
Reviewed homolog annotations describe ArgJ as bifunctional in cyclic arginine biosynthesis: N-acetylglutamate synthesis and ornithine-forming transacetylation.

entities.name: ArgJ transacetylation
observations: Rhea RHEA:15349: N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine + L-glutamate ⇌ N-acetyl-L-glutamate + L-ornithine; attributed to reviewed ArgJ homolog annotations.

entities.name: N-acetylglutamate synthesis
observations: Rhea RHEA:24292: L-glutamate + acetyl-CoA ⇌ N-acetyl-L-glutamate + CoA + H(+); attributed to reviewed ArgJ homolog annotations.
